title: Order (item 8)
description: One paid order, as GET /orders lists it (openapi.yaml, items[]) and as the by-arrangement order webhook carries it (order-event.schema.json, order). One definition, so the two never drift. Only orders that have been paid appear: an order never paid is not an order to Mervia. status is paid, refunded or cancelled; updated_at changes whenever the order is paid, refunded or cancelled, so updated_since finds every change. Mervia keeps an order's amounts from the first time it reads the order as paid; an amount change after payment is recorded as a refund raising refunded_total (a running total, not a delta), and cancelled counts as a full refund (refunded_total equal to total). No customer name, email, phone or address is returned.

number.description: The order number shown to the customer, e.g. "#10042".

status.description: paid until money goes back; refunded once any amount has been refunded; cancelled when the order was cancelled after payment (a full refund).

updated_at.description: Changes whenever the order is paid, refunded or cancelled. GET /orders?updated_since= compares against it.

total.description: What the customer paid. The basis of the ChatGPT-referred revenue Mervia reports; fixed from the first read as paid.

refunded_total.description: Cumulative amount refunded so far ("0.00" while nothing is), not a delta; for a cancelled order equal to total.

mervia_attribution.description: The raw value of the mervia_attr cookie copied onto the order at checkout, or null if the cookie was absent. The store does not parse it.

customer_key.description: Optional: SHA-256 of the lowercase email, for repeat-buyer counts. Never the email itself.

money.description: A decimal amount as a string, e.g. "129.00"
